name: Torleif Thedéen & Ensemble
description: Enjoy a free evening of exquisite classical music in a historic and atmospheric monastery setting.
longDescription:
Cellist Torleif Thedéen, a renowned Swedish musician, performs alongside an ensemble for an evening of classical music. Thedéen is celebrated for his interpretations of both classical and contemporary repertoire, having performed with major orchestras worldwide and released numerous acclaimed recordings. This event offers an opportunity to hear his artistry in a unique setting, presenting a program designed to complement the acoustics and atmosphere of the historic venue.

Attendees can expect a focused musical performance within the solemn and grand environment of the Monastery of Santa Clara-a-Nova. The concert is designed for an audience appreciative of classical music and the unique ambiance of a historic Porto monastery. The duration of the performance is approximately 60-90 minutes.

This is a free event, with admission on a walk-in basis. The Monastery of Santa Clara-a-Nova is located in the city centre, accessible by walking from various points in Porto. It is a short walk from the Bolhão metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F). Specific accessibility information for the venue is not available.
